source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 26 (PDF 145-159), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 26 (Polymers) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define polymer and monomer.
(Polymer aur monomer ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Polymers bohat bare molecules hain jo bohat se chhote molecules ko polymerisation se jor kar bante hain. Jurne wale chhote molecules monomers kehlate hain, maslan ethene poly(ethene) ka monomer hai.

book_ref.quote: Polymers are very large molecules made by joining many small molecules called monomers through polymerisation.

blocks.prompt:
2 Give one example each of a very light, soft polymer and of a hard polymer, with a use of each.
(Aik halke naram polymer aur aik sakht polymer ki misal un ke istemal ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Halka aur naram: poly(ethene), shopping bags ke liye (poly(propene) clothesline ke liye). Sakht aur garmi mein mustahkam: Kevlar®, bulletproof vests aur aerospace mein.

book_ref.quote: Some polymers are very light and soft, which are suitable for applications where soft materials are needed.

blocks.prompt:
3 How are synthetic polymers named systematically? Give two examples.
(Synthetic polymers ke systematic naam kaise rakhe jate hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Monomer ke naam se pehle "poly" likha jata hai. Polythene ka naam poly(ethene) aur polyvinylchloride ka poly(chloroethene) hai.

book_ref.quote: Synthetic polymers are named systematically by writing the prefix

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is PETE usually called by its common name?
(PETE ko aam taur par us ke aam naam se kyun pukara jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: PETE do monomers se banta hai, aur aise polymers ka systematic naam bohat lamba hota hai: poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate). Is liye aam naam polyethylene terephthalate (PETE) istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: For polymers with two or more monomers, common names are usually used because the systematic name is too long.

blocks.prompt:
5 What is polymerisation? Name its two main types.
(Polymerisation kya hai? Is ki do bari qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Monomers ko jor kar polymer banane ka amal polymerisation hai. Is ki do bari qismein addition polymerisation aur condensation polymerisation hain.

book_ref.quote: Polymerisation is the process of joining monomers to form a polymer.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define addition polymerisation. Why is it said that 'nothing is lost' in it?
(Addition polymerisation ki tareef karein. Is mein 'kuch zaya nahi hota' kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Addition polymerisation mein monomers aik aik kar ke jur kar lambi chains banate hain. Asal monomers ke tamaam atoms polymer ka hissa ban jate hain aur paani jaisa koi chhota molecule nahi banta, is liye kuch zaya nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: In addition polymerization, monomers add to each other one by one, forming long chains.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why must a monomer for addition polymerisation contain a C=C or C≡C bond? How is the reaction usually started?
(Addition polymerisation ke monomer mein C=C ya C≡C bond kyun zaroori hai? Reaction aam taur par kaise shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh multiple bond khul jata hai aur monomers ko aapas mein jurne deta hai. Reaction aksar chain reaction ki shakal mein hota hai jo aik bohat reactive molecule, initiator, shuru karta hai jo free radicals banata hai.

book_ref.quote: This bond "opens up" to allow monomers to link together.

blocks.prompt:
8 Write the equation for the formation of poly(ethene) from ethene.
(Ethene se poly(ethene) banne ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: n CH₂=CH₂ → —[CH₂—CH₂]ₙ—. Bohat se ethene molecules apne double bonds tor kar siron se jur jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Polyethene, a large number of ethene (CH₂=CH₂) molecules add together by breaking double bonds and linking end-to-end.

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between LDPE and HDPE.
(LDPE aur HDPE mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: LDPE ki chains ziyada branched hain aur yeh halka, naram aur lachakdar hai; HDPE ki chains linear aur qareeb pack hain aur yeh sakht aur dense hai.

book_ref.quote: This makes it unable to pack tightly giving a less solid and more elastic material.

rows: Jahan halka naram material chahiye: shopping bags, halki bottles
Plastic containers, mote shopping bags, khilone

blocks.prompt:
10 What is the importance of the Ziegler-Natta catalyst?
(Ziegler-Natta catalyst ki kya ahmiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Karl Ziegler ne 1953 mein daryaft kiya; is se pehli baar ethene ki kam pressure par linear HDPE mein polymerisation hui. Giulio Natta ne is se stereoregular polymers jaise crystalline polypropylene banaye; yeh Nobel Prize jeetne wali ijaad hai.

book_ref.quote: This catalyst enabled, for the first time, the low-pressure polymerisation of ethene into linear, high-density poly(ethene) (HDPE).

blocks.prompt:
11 Write the equation for the formation of PVC.
(PVC banne ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: n CH₂=CHCl → —[CH₂—CHCl]ₙ—. Chloroethene molecules addition polymerisation se jurte hain; C=C bonds khul kar units siron se jur jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Poly(chloroethene) or PVC is made from a monomer called chloroethene (CH₂=CHCl) through an addition polymerisation reaction.

blocks.prompt:
12 Define plasticizers and state how they act.
(Plasticizers ki tareef karein aur batayein ke yeh kaise kaam karte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Plasticizers woh chemicals hain jo materials mein milaye jate hain taake woh naram, lachakdar aur aasani se kaam ke qabil hon. Yeh polymer chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces kam karte hain, is se chains aazadi se harkat karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Plasticizers are chemicals added to materials to make them softer, more flexible, and easier to work with.

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between rigid PVC and plasticised PVC.
(Rigid PVC aur plasticised PVC mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Rigid PVC mein plasticizers nahi aur yeh sakht hai; plasticised PVC mein plasticizers hain aur yeh lachakdar aur naram hai.

book_ref.quote: Plasticised PVC (with plasticisers) is flexible and soft, so it can be bent and shaped easily.

rows: Sakht aur akra hua, aasani se nahi murta
Lachakdar aur naram, aasani se murta aur shakal leta hai
Chemically inert, bijli ka achha insulator
Chemical aur electrical properties achhi rehti hain

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is rigid PVC described as chemically inert and self-extinguishing?
(Rigid PVC ko chemically inert aur self-extinguishing kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh chemically inert hai kyun ke ziyada tar acids, bases ya oils se react nahi karta. Chlorine atoms ki wajah se yeh qudrati taur par jalne se bachta hai aur khud bujh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is chemically inert because it does not react with most acids, bases, or oils.

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is PVC used for water supply, drainage and sewage pipes?
(PVC paani, drainage aur sewage ke pipes ke liye kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: PVC par zang (corrosion) nahi lagta aur yeh paaidaar hai; ziyada tar acids, bases aur oils ka is par asar nahi hota, aur yeh der tak chalta aur mausam ka asar bardasht karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Pipes and fittings for water supply, drainage, and sewage systems due to its corrosion resistance and durability.

blocks.prompt:
16 Define condensation polymerisation. Name the small molecules that may be eliminated.
(Condensation polymerisation ki tareef karein. Nikalne wale chhote molecules ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Condensation polymerisation mein monomers jurte hain magar har naye bond par aik chhota molecule nikalta hai. Yeh aam taur par paani hota hai; HCl, CH₃OH ya NH₃ bhi ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: In condensation polymerisation, monomers join together, but each time a new bond forms, a small molecule is eliminated from the monomers.

blocks.prompt:
17 What structural feature must the monomers of condensation polymerisation have?
(Condensation polymerisation ke monomers mein kaun si saakhti khoobi zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Un mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (jaise -OH, -COOH, -NH₂) hone chahiye jo aapas mein react kar saken, aur yeh groups monomer ke mukhtalif siron par hon.

book_ref.quote: These groups are on different ends of the monomer(s).

blocks.prompt:
18 What are polyesters? Write the equation for the preparation of Terylene (PET).
(Polyesters kya hain? Terylene (PET) banane ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polyesters ki backbone mein ester links [—C(=O)—O—] hote hain; yeh diol aur dicarboxylic acid se paani nikal kar bante hain. n HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH + n HOOC–C₆H₄–COOH → —[O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–C₆H₄–CO]ₙ— + 2n H₂O.

book_ref.quote: A diol (molecule with two -OH groups) and a dicarboxylic acid (molecule with two -COOH groups) as monomers are combined to give polyester.

blocks.prompt:
19 Give three uses of polyesters.
(Polyesters ke teen istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Fibres, ziyada tensile strength ki wajah se, aur cotton ki jagah (sasta, silwat nahi parti). (2) Plastic: mashroobat ki PETE bottles aur khane ki packing. (3) Sakht plastics mein cross links, jaise glass fibre reinforced cross-linked polyester.

book_ref.quote: It is also used as a plastic; for example, PETE is used in making plastic bottles for beverages and other food packaging.

blocks.prompt:
20 What are polyamides? Name three types of starting materials for them.
(Polyamides kya hain? In ke liye teen qisam ke ibtidai maddon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polyamides ki backbone mein amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] hote hain. Yeh (i) diamine aur dicarboxylic acid, (ii) diamine aur dioyl chloride, (iii) amino acids se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Polyamides have amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] in their backbone. They can be prepared from many starting materials.

blocks.prompt:
21 Compare the preparation of a polyamide from a dicarboxylic acid and from a dioyl chloride.
(Dicarboxylic acid aur dioyl chloride se polyamide banane ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono diamine se react kar ke amide links banate hain; dioyl chloride ziyada reactive hai aur paani ki jagah HCl deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The -NH₂ from the diamine reacts with the -COCl from the dioyl chloride.

rows: Paani nikalta hai (n repeat units par 2n H₂O)
HCl nikalta hai (n repeat units par 2n HCl)

blocks.prompt:
22 Why does the formation of n repeat units of a polyamide from a diamine and a dicarboxylic acid release 2n H₂O, but n repeat units from an amino acid release only n H₂O?
(Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se polyamide ke n repeat units banne par 2n H₂O kyun nikalte hain, magar amino acid se sirf n H₂O kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Har link aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai. Diamine-diacid polymer ke har repeat unit mein do amide links hain, is liye 2n H₂O; amino acid wale polymer ke har unit mein aik link hai, is liye n H₂O.

book_ref.quote: Each repeat unit has two amide links and each link releases one small molecule

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Repeat unit mein jitne naye links hon, utne hi chhote molecules nikalte hain. Diamine-diacid unit mein N-H ke do siron par do amide links hain, is liye har unit do H₂O deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a peptide bond? Why are proteins called natural polyamides?
(Peptide bond kya hai? Proteins ko natural polyamides kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab aik amino acid ka -NH₂ group doosre ke -COOH group se react karta hai to paani nikalta hai aur peptide bond (-CO-NH-) banta hai jo amide linkage ki qisam hai. Proteins amino acids se aise links ke zariye bante hain, is liye natural polyamides hain.

book_ref.quote: The -NH₂ group of one amino acid reacts with the -COOH group of another amino acid removing a water to form a peptide bond.

blocks.prompt:
24 Write a general equation for the reaction of an acyl chloride with methanamine. Why does it take place at room temperature?
(Acyl chloride ke methanamine se reaction ki general equation likhein. Yeh room temperature par kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: R–COCl + CH₃–NH₂ → R–CO–NH–CH₃ + HCl. Amide linkage banta hai aur HCl gas nikalti hai. Acyl chlorides kaafi reactive hain, is liye yeh room temperature par aasani se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: When an acyl chloride reacts with ammonia or an amine, a molecule of hydrogen chloride (HCl) gas is removed.

blocks.prompt:
25 What is nylon? What are its general monomers?
(Nylon kya hai? Is ke aam monomers kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon aik synthetic polyamide hai jo condensation polymerisation se banta hai, aam taur par do mukhtalif monomers se: diamine (H₂N-R-NH₂) aur dicarboxylic acid (HOOC-R-COOH). Aik chhota molecule, aam taur par paani, nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Generally, a diamine (H₂N-R-NH₂) and a dicarboxylic acid (HOOC-R-COOH) act as monomers.

blocks.prompt:
26 Give the formula and the correct systematic name of adipic acid. Why is '1,4-hexanedioic acid' wrong?
(Adipic acid ka formula aur durust systematic naam likhein. '1,4-hexanedioic acid' ghalat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Adipic acid HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH hai. Is ke dono COOH carbons chhe carbon ki chain ke C1 aur C6 hain, is liye yeh hexanedioic acid (hexane-1,6-dioic acid) hai, 1,4- nahi.

book_ref.quote: Adipic acid, HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH, has its two COOH carbons at C1 and C6

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is the formation of nylon-6 not a typical condensation reaction, yet nylon-6 is a condensation polymer?
(Nylon-6 ka banna aam condensation reaction kyun nahi, phir bhi nylon-6 condensation polymer kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon-6 aik akele cyclic monomer caprolactam se banta hai aur koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta, is liye yeh aam condensation nahi. Phir bhi amide linkage banne ke tareeqe ki wajah se yeh condensation polymer shumaar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Another type of nylon is nylon-6, which is formed from a single monomer called caprolactam as in the following scheme.

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between nylon-6 and nylon-6,6.
(Nylon-6 aur nylon-6,6 mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nylon-6 aik monomer caprolactam se bina chhota molecule nikle banta hai; nylon-6,6 do monomers se paani nikal kar banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nylon 6 is a harder material than nylon-6,6 and provides a smoother surface and higher impact resistance

rows: Kam melting point, aasani se mold
Hamwaar satah, chot sehne ki ziyada salahiyat
Rollers, skateboard wheels, power tool handles

blocks.prompt:
29 Why are skateboard wheels made from nylon?
(Skateboard ke pahiye nylon se kyun bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke nylon sakht, hamwaar aur jhatkon se paak hai. Khaas kar nylon-6 ki satah hamwaar aur chot sehne ki salahiyat ziyada hai, is liye jhatkon se bachne ke liye skateboard wheels aur rollers mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The wheels of this skateboard are made from nylon, due to its hard, smooth, and shock-free nature.

blocks.prompt:
30 List the properties of nylon.
(Nylon ki properties likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nylon mazboot hai aur tootta nahi, ragar aur ghisaawat bardasht karta hai; elasticity ki wajah se khinch jata hai; is ki phisalne wali satah ragar kam karti hai; oils, bohat se solvents aur alkalis ka asar nahi hota; aur melting point ziyada hai.

book_ref.quote: Strong and resistant to breaking and can withstand rubbing and wear and tear.

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is nylon used for gears and bearings in the automotive industry?
(Automotive industry mein gears aur bearings nylon se kyun bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is ki taqat, kam ragar (phisalne wali satah) aur garmi bardasht karne (ziyada melting point) ki wajah se. Yahi taqat aur ghisaawat se bachao ise screws, nuts aur bolts ke liye moozoon banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Nylon is used for the manufacturing of mechanical parts of automotive industry like gears, bearings, bushings, engine covers, and fuel lines

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is nylon used for clothing such as activewear and swimwear?
(Nylon activewear aur swimwear jaise kapron mein kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon mazboot aur lachakdar (khinchne wala) hai, is liye stockings, activewear, swimwear aur qaleenon mein istemal hota hai; is ka kapra raincoats aur sportswear mein bhi lagta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used for clothing (stockings, activewear, and swimwear), carpets, and ropes due to its strength and elasticity.

blocks.text: 26.3 Identifying the Type, Repeat Unit and Monomers of a Polymer

blocks.prompt:
33 How can you decide from the backbone whether a polymer is an addition or a condensation polymer?
(Backbone dekh kar kaise faisla karein ke polymer addition hai ya condensation?)
blocks.explanation: Main chain ke atoms dekhein. Agar sirf carbon (-C-C-C-C-) ho to alkenes se bana addition polymer hai. Agar carbon ke saath O ya N ho to condensation polymer (polyester ya polyamide) hai.

book_ref.quote: The first thing to check is what atoms make up the main horizontal chain of the polymer

blocks.prompt:
34 How do you tell a polyester from a polyamide by its functional linkage?
(Functional linkage se polyester aur polyamide mein kaise pehchan karein?)
blocks.explanation: Agar carbonyl group (C=O) seedha O ke saath ho to ester linkage hai: polyester (jaise PET). Agar C=O seedha H wale N ke saath ho to amide (peptide) linkage hai: polyamide (jaise nylon-6,6, Kevlar).

book_ref.quote: Now, identify the functional linkage. There are again two possibilities:

blocks.prompt:
35 What is a repeat unit? How is it shown?
(Repeat unit kya hai? Ise kaise dikhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Repeat unit polymer ka sab se chhota hissa hai jo baar baar dohrata hai. Dekhein sequence kahan se dohrana shuru hota hai, aik aise hisse ke gird brackets lagayein aur subscript n likhein.

book_ref.quote: 2. Determining the Repeat Unit: To find the original monomers, one must first identify the smallest section that repeats itself in the section of the polymer.

blocks.prompt:
36 Identify the repeat unit and the monomer of the addition polymer section -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-.
(Addition polymer ke hisse -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)- ka repeat unit aur monomer pehchanein.)
blocks.explanation: Repeat unit: —[CH₂—CH(C₆H₅)]ₙ—. C-C single bond ko wapis C=C banane se monomer CH₂=CH-C₆H₅, phenyl ethene (styrene) milta hai.

book_ref.quote: a) For addition polymers, change the C-C single bond in the repeat unit back into a C=C double bond to find the monomer.

blocks.prompt:
37 How are the monomers of a condensation polymer found from its repeat unit? Apply it to the ester link -CO-O-.
(Condensation polymer ke repeat unit se monomers kaise maloom kiye jate hain? Ise ester link -CO-O- par lagayein.)
blocks.explanation: Paani wapis jorein: ester ya amide bond torein, C=O wali taraf -OH aur O ya N wali taraf -H lagayein. -CO-O- mein C=O wali taraf -COOH (acid) aur O wali taraf -OH (alcohol) ban jati hai.

book_ref.quote: b) For Condensation polymers: Add water back in. Break the ester or amide bond.

blocks.prompt:
38 Classify the following by Table 26.1: PTFE, PLA, nylon-6,6, PVC.
(Table 26.1 ke mutabiq darja bandi karein: PTFE, PLA, nylon-6,6, PVC.)
blocks.explanation: PTFE (poly(tetrafluoroethene)) aur PVC: addition polymers (chain mein sirf C-C bonds). PLA: polyester (-COO- links). Nylon-6,6: polyamide (-CONH- links).

book_ref.quote: Poly(ethene), PVC, PTFE (poly (tetrafluoroethene))

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is Kevlar placed both among polyamides and among aromatic polymers in Table 26.1?
(Table 26.1 mein Kevlar polyamides aur aromatic polymers dono mein kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kevlar mein -CONH- (amide) links hain, is liye polyamide hai; is ki chain mein benzene rings bhi hain, is liye aromatic polymer bhi hai.

book_ref.quote: Benzene rings in the chain

blocks.prompt:
40 Predict the type of polymerisation for ethene, propene and phenyl ethene. Give a reason.
(Ethene, propene aur phenyl ethene ke liye polymerisation ki qisam batayein aur wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Teeno addition polymerisation karte hain, kyun ke har monomer mein C=C bond hai.

book_ref.quote: When the given monomer(s) contains C=C bonds, addition polymerisation will take place.

blocks.prompt:
41 Differentiate between a homopolymer and a copolymer formed by addition polymerisation.
(Addition polymerisation se bane homopolymer aur copolymer mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Homopolymer aik qisam ke monomer se banta hai; copolymer double bond wale do mukhtalif monomers se.

book_ref.quote: sometimes copolymerisation of two different monomers having double bond can also be achieved

rows: C=C wala aik qisam ka monomer
Do mukhtalif monomers, har aik mein double bond
Addition polymerisation mein ziyada tar yahi banta hai
Misal: ethene aur propenoic acid (H₂C=CH-COOH) ka copolymer

blocks.prompt:
42 Name the four pairs of functional groups that undergo condensation polymerisation, with the polymer and small molecule formed by each.
(Condensation polymerisation karne wale functional groups ke chaar jore, har aik ke polymer aur chhote molecule ke saath, likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) NH₂ + COOH → polyamide + H₂O. (2) NH₂ + COCl → polyamide + HCl. (3) COOH + OH → polyester + H₂O. (4) COCl + OH → polyester + HCl.

book_ref.quote: The common functional groups that can undergo condensation polymerisation are:

blocks.prompt:
43 Predict the polymer formed from HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH and ClOC–C₆H₄–COCl and name the small molecule eliminated.
(HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH aur ClOC–C₆H₄–COCl se banne wala polymer batayein aur nikalne wale chhote molecule ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: OH groups COCl groups se react karte hain, is liye condensation se polyester banta hai aur HCl nikalta hai: n HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH + n ClOC–C₆H₄–COCl → —[O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–C₆H₄–CO]ₙ— + 2n HCl.

book_ref.quote: acyl chlorides (COCl) and alcohols (OH) (polyester and HCl).

blocks.prompt:
44 How can lactic acid alone form a condensation polymer? Name the polymer.
(Lactic acid akela condensation polymer kaise bana sakta hai? Polymer ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Zaroori dono functional groups (-OH aur -COOH) lactic acid ke aik hi molecule mein hain, is liye is ke molecules ester links se aapas mein jur jate hain. Polymer poly(lactic acid), PLA, aik polyester hai.

book_ref.quote: The two functional group may exist in a single molecule (e.g. lactic acid) or two different molecules, as in the case of nylon 6,6.

blocks.prompt:
45 What are non-degradable polymers? Why are they an environmental nuisance?
(Non-degradable polymers kya hain? Yeh mahol ke liye museebat kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Poly(ethene) jaise aam polymers non-degradable hain: yeh saade, ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot nahi sakte. Is liye phenkne ke baad yeh baqi rehte hain aur paani, mitti aur jaandaron ke qudrati maskan ka hissa ban jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Non-degradable means that these polymers cannot be broken down into simpler, non-toxic compounds

blocks.prompt:
46 What are microplastics? How can they harm humans?
(Microplastics kya hain? Yeh insaanon ko kaise nuqsan de sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Microplastics woh nihayat chhote tukre hain jo non-degradable plastic ke bare tukron ke waqt ke saath tootne se bante hain. Yeh mitti, paani aur hawa mein phail jate hain aur food chain (ghizai zanjeer) mein daakhil ho kar insaani sehat ko nuqsan de sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: These microplastics spread everywhere, polluting soil, water, and even the air.

blocks.prompt:
47 Define biodegradable plastic. Why do starch-containing plastics degrade faster?
(Biodegradable plastic ki tareef karein. Starch wale plastics jaldi kyun toot jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Biodegradable plastic woh hai jo kuch arsa dabane par microorganisms se saade ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot jaye. Starch natural polymer hai aur mitti ke bacteria natural polymers par aasani se hamla karte hain, is liye aise plastics jaldi toot jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The plastic that is naturally decomposed by microorganism into simpler non-toxic compounds when buried for a certain period is called biodegradable plastic.

blocks.prompt:
48 What are photodegradable polymers? Why are carbonyl groups built into some of them?
(Photodegradable polymers kya hain? Kuch mein carbonyl groups kyun rakhe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Photodegradable polymers mein aise functional groups hote hain jo dhoop (UV) se ziyada energy jazb karte hain, is liye roshni se toot jate hain. Chains mein carbonyl groups (C=O) ziyada photoabsorption ke liye rakhe jate hain; jazb shuda UV light chain ke bonds aur chains ke darmiyan forces ko kamzor karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Polymers with such functionalities can be degraded by light and are termed as photodegradable.

blocks.prompt:
49 State three limitations of photodegradable plastics.
(Photodegradable plastics ki teen khamiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh der tak istemal nahi ho sakte. (2) In ki recycling achhi nahi hoti. (3) Plastic landfills mein dabaya jata hai jahan photodegradation ke liye roshni nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: However, photodegradable plastics cannot be used for longer time and recycling of such polymers is not efficient.

blocks.prompt:
50 How is the slow hydrolysis of polyesters used in medicine?
(Polyesters ki aahista hydrolysis tibb (medicine) mein kaise kaam aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aise materials banaye ja sakte hain jo zaroorat khatam hone par toot jayen. Kuch medical implants aur ghul jane wale taanke polyesters se bante hain jo jism mein hydrolysis se aahista toot jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Scientists and engineers can use this knowledge to design materials that break down when they are no longer needed.

blocks.prompt:
51 What are artificial organs? List the requirements of polymers used in them.
(Artificial organs kya hain? In mein istemal hone wale polymers ki zaroori khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Artificial organs insaan ke banaye aalaat hain jo kharab ya beemar aaza ki jagah lete ya un ke kaam mein madad dete hain. In ke polymers biocompatible, mechanically moozoon, sterilize hone ke qabil, paaidaar aur tunable hone chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Polymers used in the body need to be biocompatible, mechanically suitable, sterilizable, durable and tunable.

blocks.prompt:
52 Explain the terms biocompatible and tunable for polymers in artificial organs.
(Artificial organs ke polymers ke liye biocompatible aur tunable ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Biocompatible: polymer jism ko nuqsan na de, allergy na kare aur immune system ise radd na kare. Tunable: is ki taqat, lachak ya elasticity jism ke hisse ke mutabiq badli ja sake, jaise khoon ki naaliyon ke liye lachakdar, haddiyon ke liye mazboot.

book_ref.quote: flexible for blood vessels, strong for bones

blocks.prompt:
53 Which polymers are used for artificial blood vessels, and why?
(Artificial blood vessels mein kaun se polymers istemal hote hain aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: PTFE (poly(tetrafluoroethylene)) aur PET (poly(ethylene terephthalate)). Yeh hamwaar satah dete hain jo khoon jamne se rokti hai, aur band naaliyon ki jagah lene ya bypass ke liye istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Smooth surfaces to prevent blood clots; used to replace or bypass blocked vessels.

blocks.prompt:
54 Name the polymers used for an artificial cornea and state the properties they must have.
(Artificial cornea ke polymers ke naam aur un ki zaroori khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) aur hydrogels. Inhen bilkul shaffaf (transparent) aur biocompatible hona chahiye taake nazar wapis aaye.

book_ref.quote: Must be perfectly clear (transparent) and biocompatible to restore vision.

blocks.prompt:
55 Why is UHMWPE used in artificial hip and knee joints?
(Artificial hip aur knee joints mein UHMWPE kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene hamwaar aur kam ragar wali satah deta hai jo harkat mein madad deti aur ghisaawat ka muqabla karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Provides a smooth, low-friction surface to allow movement and resist wear.
